text: {"requester":{"id":"lab-user-0427","cls":"researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFe-Co OER screening: thermal crystallization series","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2219","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Load fresh FTO plate for standard deposition series"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"Confirm plate identity before deposition"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2219"},"comment":"Standard initialization"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni50Fe30Co20 baseline, 200 nm"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":7200,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Crystallization anneal per standard protocol (setpoint label: 'std_high'); exceeds FTO substrate thermal limit, which is the intended I2 violation for this test"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.5,"y":8.0},"comment":"Locate deposited spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, routine"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"P-2219"},"comment":"Ingest CP data into surrogate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"1 h stability check"}]}
